cases.note: A folder links itself, its . and each subfolder's ..; an entry takes whole 4 KiB blocks for its bytes, none when empty or a symlink short enough to sit in its inode. ls -l, ls -s, stat %h %b, find -links and find -printf %n %b %k all read the same counts (debian:stable-slim on ext4).
